files_note: house re-statement of the carried fpf_pallas triangle-attention block in float32 (the pallas_call wrappers and kernel bodies re-stated with f32 out-shapes, head-channel chunking and the bias FMAs; the math helpers _ln / LOG2E / NEG / the compiler-params class are IMPORTED from the carried fpf_pallas.triattn_pallas, not copied); standard library at import, jax on first use
license: Apache-2.0 (this repository's own code: common/opt_core/LICENSE); extends the AlphaFold 3 source (Apache-2.0, Copyright 2024 DeepMind Technologies Limited) — no upstream file carried
mechanism: attn.triangle_attention + attn.triangle_multiplication (JAX Pallas-Triton; f32 activations and parameters; attention = prologue LN+q|k|v|pair-bias, flash core, epilogue LN-recompute+gate+W_o(+biases); multiplication = prologue LN+left|right projections(+bias) x mask x gates(+bias) to channel-major planes, ONE XLA batched f32 GEMM, epilogue centre-LN+W_out(+bias) x gate(+bias); MMAs f32 x f32 -> f32 at a named operand precision REQUIRED per call: tf32 (tensor cores, the fast word) | tf32x3 (dot-algorithm preset only) | ieee (CUDA-core FMA reference))
name: fpf_pallas_f32
runtime_imports_note: imports opt_core.kernels.fpf_pallas_serve and, through it, the carried fpf_pallas.triattn_pallas helpers on first use (a kit that routes fpf_pallas routes what this module reads)
served_note: grid_self_attention_fused_f32(act [N,N,C] f32, pair_mask, kp = fpf_pallas_serve.attn_params(..., weights_dtype=float32), transpose=, cfg=, precision=) and triangle_multiplication_fused_f32(act, mask, p = fpf_pallas_serve.trimul_params(f32 arrays), equation='outgoing'|'incoming', cfg=, precision=) -> [N,N,C] f32; served through fpf_pallas_serve.tri_attn_block / trimul_block (float32 activations route here after the per-call pad to kernel_n; SERVED line word mma=<precision>); precision REQUIRED on every call (None/'std' -> precision_required); 'ieee' = CUDA-core FMA, f32-exact, 45-60x the tf32 time (validation only); 'tf32' = the fast word (both blocks); 'tf32x3' = f32-class, faster than the stock-like XLA body for the attention and slower for the multiplication; JAXF32 measured timing (0.5.5 bytes, H100, C=128, ms per call, tf32x3 | tf32 | XLA-default f32 body | XLA HIGHEST): triangle attention N=448 2.20 | 1.18 | 4.36 | 5.36, N=1024 16.05 | 8.51 | 45.8 | 54.4 (tf32x3 err 4-5e-7; tf32 2.3e-4 == XLA-default); triangle multiplication N=448 2.24 | 0.81 | 1.74 | 2.81, N=1024 12.67 | 3.29 | 8.22 | 15.6; ieee = 45-60x tf32 (validation only) (tensor-core tf32 operands; the class of a stock f32 model's GEMMs on sm_80+; the pinned numerics/timing: rel-rms vs HIGHEST reference 1.7-7.1e-4 attention / 3.4-6.2e-4 multiplication, kernel x2.6-5.9 attention / x1.5-2.5 multiplication vs the pure-jnp f32 body, H100); 'tf32x3' = DotAlgorithmPreset.TF32_TF32_F32_X3 only (5-6e-7; raises on a jax without the preset); tiles = TILE_TABLES[cc] rows attn_f32_default / attn_f32_by_n / trimul_f32 {t1 64, w1 4, hc1 32, t2 64, w2 4, hc2 32, ein xla} / trimul_f32_by_n (H100 rows; other capabilities refuse no_tiles: no-f32-tiles:<cc>); numerics class per jax line (fpf_pallas_serve.F32_LINES / f32_class): jax>=0.10 tf32 = the XLA body's class (round-to-nearest operands), jax 0.5 tf32 = bf16-operand class over a block (truncated operands, per-dot 7.7e-4 vs 2.9e-4) and the attention's 'ieee' unlaunchable there (refused by name; the multiplication's launches)
